purpose: Teach: 長期間/しまわ/すんなり/売り切れ/兆し/区切り/近日/工具

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、長期間、内偵を進めてまいりました。
lines.en: We've been conducting undercover surveillance on this case for an extended period.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Steady voice, no hurry. Slight pause after "case" — setting the frame. Composed authority without coldness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠品、警察にしまわないようにと言われ、保管中です。
lines.en: Yes. We were instructed to keep the evidence secure and not hand it over to police custody yet. We're maintaining it properly.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Clipped efficiency — showing he understands the chain of custody. Not defensive, just precise and responsive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、すんなり、自供に至りました。
lines.en: The suspect came forward with a confession without resistance.
lines.style: Neutral report. Light emphasis on "without resistance." Professional distance — stating fact, not judgment. Even pace, no color.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害品、市場で売り切れ、追跡しております。
lines.en: Yes. The stolen goods have sold out on the market. We're tracing them now.
lines.style: Steady, focused. Acknowledgment first, then the update. Voice stays level — problem identified, work underway. No apology or overstatement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域、治安回復の兆し、感じます。
lines.en: I'm sensing signs of the neighborhood's peace being restored.
lines.style: Quieter than before. Slight warmth beneath the procedural tone — this matters. Gentle emphasis on "restored." A moment of professional satisfaction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。捜査の一区切り、現場会議、開催予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to hold a briefing at the site once we've reached this checkpoint in the investigation.
lines.style: Clear, confirmatory. Organized delivery — listing the next step. Competent and ready. Steady eye contact implied in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 近日、地域防犯活動を、実施いたします。
lines.en: We'll be implementing a community crime-prevention initiative in the coming days.
lines.style: Formal announcement tone. Deliberate pace on the key phrase — showing intent. Official but not cold. This is a commitment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。盗難に遭った工具、被害届、提出済みです。
lines.en: Yes. The report for the stolen tools has already been filed.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Quiet close on the statement — administrative detail, all handled. Professional punctuation. A small closure.
